$comment: Every subscription the owner pays for, in USD a month, from the month it started. It counts
inside the $50 all-in operating cap beside the model share (budget-2026-08f).
Apify Starter: assumed from the owner's 2026-09-15 note that the account is on a paid tier;
Starter is the cheapest one, $19 a month for $19 of platform credit. Correct the name and
amount here if the plan is another; APIFY_MONTHLY_CREDIT_USD in orchestrator/src/sources/apify.ts
carries the matching credit and must change with it.
confirmedNoFixedCosts is the flag for an empty list that means $0 rather than unmeasured; it
comes back only if every subscription below is cancelled.
Entry shape: name, monthly_usd, category, since.
